image_prompt: A photorealistic overhead flat-lay shot of a vibrant Indian mango pickle making scene on a warm wooden kitchen countertop, square 1:1 format, bright natural sunlight streaming from a window on the left. Center frame features a rustic ceramic bowl filled with freshly cut raw green mango pieces glistening with turmeric and red chilli powder. Surrounding it: small brass bowls containing yellow mustard seeds, whole fenugreek seeds, bright red Kashmiri chilli powder, golden hing powder, and a small glass bottle of cold-pressed mustard oil. video_prompt: A cinematic 9:16 vertical video, 8 seconds, shot in a sun-drenched modern Indian kitchen with warm terracotta and white tones.
